# Service catalog

<!-- Generated by `cargo run -p xtask -- graph`; do not edit. -->

Generated from the real assembly: the App Server product profile (`serve` with a product home, sharing the names it shares when it hosts foreign parts) with one Session and its `main` branch. `cargo run -p xtask -- check` fails when this file is stale. The rules for names are in [How Dim uses rutis §3](../../../design/rutis-usage.md#3-services-by-name).

## Services

Each catalog name a part of the assembly provides or injects. A name that crosses languages lists the methods its dispatcher serves, each `sync` or `async` (callers in other languages always get a Promise); other methods of its Rust type are Rust-only. A Rust-only name has no dispatcher: Rust parts reach it at its type's key.
